items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember a guy named Estavil (PHONETIC) we used to record with? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was just the time everybody had buried Louis, said he's through, he's lost his chops, you know. And oh, this dynamite record came out.
Scared everybody to death. You remember a guy named Estavil (PHONETIC) we used to record with? Mexican piano player at RCA.
